name: GitHub Organization Two-Factor Authentication Enforcement Review
description: Creates a task when GitHub does not report organization-wide two-factor authentication enforcement as enabled.

mapping.task_title_template: Enable two-factor authentication enforcement for GitHub organization {{ record.login|default:'organization' }}
mapping.additional_information_template: GitHub organization {{ record.login|default:'not returned' }} (organization ID {{ record.id|default:'not returned' }}) did not report two-factor authentication enforcement as enabled. Reported value: {% if record.two_factor_requirement_enabled == None or record.two_factor_requirement_enabled == '' %}not returned{% else %}{{ record.two_factor_requirement_enabled }}{% endif %}. Confirm the request used an organization-owner token with access to full organization details, then enable an approved two-factor authentication requirement in GitHub.
